## Controller 1.0.51 (72)
### Connect - Connect recovers an unreachable OpenTunnel route when a phone or another Mac reports it can't reach this Mac, instead of waiting for the tunnel to fail on its own.
### iPhone, iPad and Android - A settled chat's question no longer stays on the Live Activity or the Android Live Update. - Opening a finished conversation keeps the transcript at the latest message. - On an unfolded iPhone Duo or an iPad, the chat list's sidebar shows one search button instead of two. - With the sidebar hidden on an unfolded iPhone Duo, the chat's title bar stays in place while you scroll.
### Mac - New chats offer **Attach Pull Request** only for GitHub checkouts, as a quiet link. - Updating Antigravity replaces its runtime when you ask for the update, and unused versions are removed.

## Controller 1.0.51 (71)
- **Settings → Connect Repos** on the Mac manages every project's Connect repository in one place. Link or unlink a project, create an encrypted repository named after its folder, turn **Sync automatically** on or off, and link, change or remove each repository's GitHub mirror. - **Delete Repository…** removes a Connect repository from your Mac, iPhone or iPad. Your checkouts are unlinked right away, and Connect purges the repository's data a day later. - Agents publish to Connect Repositories more smoothly. A commit on the default branch starts syncing as soon as the agent's turn ends, `connect_repo_push` waits for the GitHub mirror and reports its result, and a push that races auto-sync to the same commit no longer reports a conflict. Agents are also told how the linked repository, auto-sync and the mirror behave. - Connect Repos errors now give Connect's actual reason, for example when another repository already uses that GitHub link, instead of always asking you to fetch and merge. - When Cursor's SDK bridge stops, the thread shows its exit status and its last error lines. - Antigravity 1.4.0 is supported, including its separate thinking-level picker. - Fixed hangs while Controller builds a project's vocabulary profile, and a crash on iPhone and iPad during composer animations. Connect settings and repository lists also do less work per row.

## Controller 1.0.51 (70)
- Connect Repositories sync on their own. New commits on a linked repository's default branch reach Connect within about half a minute, and from there your GitHub mirror. Commits from your other Macs and from GitHub are fetched in the background, and a clean checkout fast-forwards. Turn it off per checkout with **Sync automatically** in Git Actions. - Encrypted repositories now open on your iPhone, Android phone and other Macs. A Mac that has a repository's key hands it over Connect's end-to-end encrypted connection when one of your devices connects to it. - **Replace History** in Git Actions deliberately rewrites a branch in Connect after an amend, rebase, squash or reset. The GitHub mirror follows with a protected force push, but only if GitHub has nothing that the replaced history didn't already have.
